title: Copy a code from a page in Firefox into a note in Mousepad

capabilities.why: Firefox (ESR or not), Mousepad, python3 for the page's server, and xdotool, which setup places the windows with.
argv: (command -v firefox-esr || command -v firefox) && command -v mousepad && command -v python3 && command -v xdotool

setup.why: Write the page (the asked order's code is two digits and this run's nonce, beside two decoy orders), a fresh Firefox profile that skips the first-run pages, and an empty note.

argv:
d=/tmp/computer-bench-{{nonce}}; rm -rf $d && mkdir -p $d/site $d/profile && : > $d/notes-{{nonce}}.txt || exit 1
cat > $d/site/index.html <<'PAGE'
{{file:index.html}}
PAGE
cat > $d/profile/user.js <<'JS'
{{file:user.js}}
JS

setup.why: Prove the page is served before the agent starts (10 s at most).

argv: for i in $(seq 1 50); do python3 -c 'import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:{{port}}/", timeout=1)' 2>/dev/null && exit 0; sleep 0.2; done; echo the page is not served on port {{port}} >&2; exit 1

setup.why: Open Firefox on the page, with the run's profile.

argv: export DISPLAY=:$(ls /tmp/.X11-unix | sed -n s/^X//p | head -n1); b=$(command -v firefox-esr || command -v firefox); exec $b --new-instance --profile /tmp/computer-bench-{{nonce}}/profile http://127.0.0.1:{{port}}/

setup.why: Wait for Firefox's window (40 s at most) and give it the left half of the screen.

argv: export DISPLAY=:$(ls /tmp/.X11-unix | sed -n s/^X//p | head -n1); w=$(timeout 40 xdotool search --sync --onlyvisible --class firefox | head -n1); [ -n "$w" ] || { echo no Firefox window in 40 s >&2; exit 1; }; sleep 3; eval $(xdotool getdisplaygeometry --shell); xdotool windowmove $w 0 0 windowsize $w $((WIDTH / 2)) $HEIGHT

setup.why: Open the empty note in Mousepad.

argv: export DISPLAY=:$(ls /tmp/.X11-unix | sed -n s/^X//p | head -n1); cd /tmp/computer-bench-{{nonce}} && exec mousepad /tmp/computer-bench-{{nonce}}/notes-{{nonce}}.txt

setup.why: Wait for Mousepad's window (20 s at most), give it the right half of the screen, put the pointer on it and activate it: a window manager gives the keys to the window activated, and with none they go to the window under the pointer.

argv: export DISPLAY=:$(ls /tmp/.X11-unix | sed -n s/^X//p | head -n1); w=$(timeout 20 xdotool search --sync --onlyvisible --class mousepad | head -n1); [ -n "$w" ] || { echo no Mousepad window in 20 s >&2; exit 1; }; eval $(xdotool getdisplaygeometry --shell); h=$((WIDTH / 2)); xdotool windowmove $w $h 0 windowsize $w $h $HEIGHT; xdotool mousemove $((h + h / 2)) $((HEIGHT / 2)); xdotool windowactivate $w 2>/dev/null; sleep 1

instruction: Firefox (left) shows today's pickup codes. Find the pickup code of the {{o.ask}} order there. Then, in Mousepad (right), where notes-{{nonce}}.txt is open, write the line "pickup: <the code>" and save the file.

checks.why: The saved note holds the one line with the {{o.ask}} order's code, {{o.p}}{{nonce}} (blank space around it aside); a decoy order's code ({{o.c1}}, {{o.c2}}) fails. The code holds this run's nonce and is only on the page, so it can't be known without reading it; setup's note is empty, so an agent that does nothing fails.

teardown.why: Close Mousepad (KILL: it holds on to a changed document on TERM) and Firefox, stop the run's server (the brackets keep pkill's patterns from matching this shell), and delete the run's folder.

argv: pkill -9 -x mousepad; pkill -9 -f 'computer-bench-{{nonce}}/profil[e]'; pkill -9 -f 'computer-bench-{{nonce}}/sit[e]'; sleep 1; rm -rf /tmp/computer-bench-{{nonce}}; true

oracle.why: The pointer is on Mousepad: type the line and Save (Ctrl+S); the note has a name, so no dialog. The oracle knows the code, so it does not read the page: it proves the check reads the saved note, and that the editor's half of the path works.
